newsitem.title: USA: Revco says CEO to leave after transition.
newsitem.headline: Revco says CEO to leave after transition.

text.p: Revco D.S. Inc said chief executive officer Dwayne Hoven will participate in the treansition accompanying the drugstore chain's planned merger with CVS Corp, but he will not remain with CVS after the union is completed.
"He will stay through the transition. He is intently interested in seeing to it that his people in Twinsburg are well taken care of," a Revco spokeswoman said.
In announcing the merger earlier Friday, CVS and Revco said Revco's Twinsburg, Ohio headquarters will be phased out over time.
Sources familiar with the companies estimate that most of the 1,000 people employed at the Revco headquarters are likely to lose their jobs.
Revco declined to comment on the expected job loss. The statement released by both firms earlier said that few other lay-offs are expected.
